blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo produzir um editorial com condicionais mistos.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: If We Had Listened, We Would Be Safer
paras: If scientists **had been listened to** thirty years ago, we **would be facing** fewer climate risks today. If governments **were** braver, they **would have acted** sooner. But if we **act** now, we **can still** reduce the damage.
**In my opinion**, the lesson is clear: **if we want** a safer future, **we must stop** delaying.

items.q: Scientists were listened to thirty years ago.
items.why: if … had been listened to (they weren’t).

items.q: We can still reduce the damage.

head: Combinação
Exemplo
rows: If scientists had been listened to, we would be safer.
If governments were braver, they would have acted.
If we act now, we can reduce the damage.
In my opinion, the lesson is clear.

blocks.body: Editorial persuasivo: **passado perdido → presente consequente → futuro possível**.

items.s: If scientists had been listened to, we ___ be safer. (would)
If governments were braver, they would have ___ . (act, part.)
If we act now, we ___ reduce damage. (can)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Better late than never.** — Antes tarde do que nunca.
**The time is now.** — A hora é agora.
**Heed the warning.** — Dar ouvidos ao alerta.
**Can we still act?** — Ainda podemos agir?
**If we had listened, we would be safer.** — Se tivéssemos escutado, estaríamos mais seguros.
**If governments were braver, they would have acted.** — Se os governos fossem mais corajosos, teriam agido.
**Get the green light.** — Receber sinal verde.

blocks.title: Debate
lines: If we had listened, we would be safer.
Se tivéssemos escutado, estaríamos mais seguros.
If governments were braver, they would have acted.
Se os governos fossem mais corajosos, teriam agido.
Yes. If we act now, we can reduce the damage.
Sim. Se agirmos agora, podemos reduzir o dano.

prompts.model: If I had listened, I’d be safer.
In my opinion, we must act.

blocks.task: Write a 6-line editorial using mixed conditionals.
blocks.model: If scientists had been listened to thirty years ago, we would be facing fewer climate risks today. If governments were braver, they would have acted sooner. But if we act now, we can still reduce the damage. In my opinion, the lesson is clear. If we want a safer future, we must stop delaying. The time to act is now.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
